description: Fauji Fertilizer Company Limited is a Pakistani fertilizer producer founded in 1978 as a joint venture with Haldor Topsoe. It is the country's largest urea producer, with capacity of more than 3 million tonnes a year from plants at Goth Machhi near Sadiqabad and at Mirpur Mathelo in Sindh, and sells under the Sona brand. The company also owns FFC Energy Limited, a wholly owned 49.5 MW wind-power subsidiary, and holds 100% of Foundation Wind Energy-I and 80% of Foundation Wind Energy-II.
headOffice: Sona Tower, 156 The Mall, Rawalpindi, Pakistan

products.name: Sona Urea (Granular)
products.summary: Large-grain urea containing 46% nitrogen, with 2-4 mm granules for top dressing in standing crops.

products.name: Sona Boron DAP
products.summary: An enhanced-efficiency DAP carrying 18% nitrogen, 46% phosphorus and 0.1% boron — described by FFC as the first of its kind in Pakistan.

products.name: Sona Urea (Zinc Coated)
products.summary: 42% nitrogen with 1% zinc, formulated as an enhanced-efficiency compound fertilizer.

products.name: Sona Urea (Neem Coated)
products.summary: 46% nitrogen urea coated with azadirachtin to slow nitrification and prolong nutrient availability.

products.name: FFC SOP
products.summary: Potassium sulphate fertilizer with 50% K2O and 18% sulphur.

products.name: FFC MOP
products.summary: Muriate of potash, the company's most concentrated potash fertilizer at 60% K2O.
